meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将个人微信接入你的应用,扫码即可收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想给项目加上个人微信消息收发能力。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your app to personal WeChat via official API for messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs personal WeChat messaging.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在你的项目里添加微信个人号适配器，装好依赖并跑通测试，再引导你扫码登录；完成接入后，别人通过微信发来的消息能让 NanoClaw 助手自动回复。
howto.when: 当你说要给 NanoClaw 接入微信、启用微信个人号通道，或让机器人在微信里收发消息时，Claude 会执行此流程。

say.text: 把微信通道加进来，我扫个码就能用。
say.note: 会开始复制适配器、装依赖，并提示你扫码。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 和微信连起来。
say.note: 会完成登录和接线，之后微信消息能触发助手回复。

say.text: 让微信消息走管理员审批模式再进助手。
say.note: 陌生人来消息会先弹审批卡片。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude adds the WeChat adapter to NanoClaw, installs dependencies, runs the tests, and prompts you to scan a QR to log in. Then WeChat messages can trigger auto-replies from the assistant.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to connect NanoClaw to WeChat, enable the personal WeChat channel, or let the bot send/receive WeChat messages.

say_en.text: Add the WeChat channel so I can scan the QR and use it.
say_en.note: It starts copying the adapter, installing dependencies, and prompts you to scan.
It completes login and wiring so WeChat messages trigger assistant replies.

say_en.text: Make WeChat messages require admin approval before reaching the assistant.
say_en.note: A stranger's first message fires an approval card.
